description: DECISION: Skip classification entirely. Pass full context to the LLM agent and let it decide whether to answer, modify, implement, or ask for clarification. Rule-based keyword matching is too fragile and duplicates intent-detection work the agent does anyway. Capability grants should be handled by giving the agent appropriate permissions up front. This ticket is intentionally not implemented.
title: Rule-based task classifier (answer / modify_existing_pr / implement_issue / clarify / ignore)
